Mouseover heal.description: Try a living friendly mouseover, then the default target. Replace the spell for your class.

Focus interrupt.description: Interrupt a living hostile focus, with your current target as fallback.

Modifier cast.description: Hold Shift for Frostbolt; otherwise cast Fireball.

Mouseover debuff.description: Use a living hostile mouseover, then your default target.

Ground target.description: Place a supported ground-targeted spell at the cursor.

Target sequence.description: Advance on each successful press; reset on target change or after the idle interval.

Trinkets.description: Attempt to activate both equipped trinkets; shared cooldowns still apply.

Pet attack.description: Send your pet to your living hostile target.

Mouseover focus.description: Set focus from mouseover, falling back to the current target.

body: /cast [mod:ctrl] Berserker Stance; [mod:shift] Defensive Stance; Battle Stance
Stance selector.description:
No modifier: Battle Stance. Shift: Defensive Stance. Ctrl: Berserker Stance. Ctrl takes priority if both keys are held. Put the macro on a key available in every stance.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Charge dance.description:
If needed, the first press selects Battle Stance; a later press attempts Charge. This does not bypass Charge's range, combat, or cooldown requirements.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Overpower dance.description:
Select Battle Stance when needed, then press again for Overpower. The macro does not check whether Overpower is available or whether you have enough rage.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Taunt dance.description:
Select Defensive Stance when needed. Once there, taunt a living hostile mouseover or your current target. A stance change and the taunt use separate presses.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Pummel dance.description:
Select Berserker Stance when needed, then press again to Pummel a living hostile focus or your current target. Requires Pummel and enough rage.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

body: /cast [nocombat,nostance:1] Battle Stance; [combat,nostance:3] Berserker Stance; [nocombat] Charge; Intercept
Charge/Intercept.description:
Out of combat, choose Battle Stance then Charge. In combat, choose Berserker Stance then Intercept. Each press chooses one action; it does not pick based on range or cooldown. Requires both abilities.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Berserker Rage.description:
Select Berserker Stance when needed; press again for Berserker Rage. Remains in Berserker Stance afterward, so returning to another stance is your choice.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Stance interrupt.description:
Use Pummel in Berserker Stance, or Shield Bash in Battle/Defensive with a shield equipped. This sample preserves your stance and does not equip a shield for you.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Stance cooldown.description:
Use Retaliation in Battle, Shield Wall in Defensive, or Recklessness in Berserker. Preserves your stance; you must know the selected ability and meet its equipment/cooldown requirements.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

Cat form.description:
Enter Cat Form without toggling it off on repeated presses. The ! prefix prevents toggling off; it does not perform a powershift.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Bear form.description:
Enter Bear Form without toggling it off on repeated presses. Replace Bear Form with Dire Bear Form in both lines if that is the version you use.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Travel forms.description:
Swimming selects Aquatic Form before the outdoor check; otherwise outdoors selects Travel Form and indoors selects Cat Form. Learn each selected form first. The ! prefix prevents toggling it off.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Bear/Cat switch.description:
From Bear (slot 1), select Cat; from other states, select Bear. Replace Bear Form with Dire Bear Form if appropriate. Check the Bear slot with Inspect forms.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Cat Prowl.description:
Select Cat Form if needed, then press again to Prowl while out of combat and not already stealthed. Repeated presses keep Prowl active. Assumes Cat is slot 3.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Cat Dash.description:
Select Cat Form if needed; a later press attempts Dash. Assumes Cat is slot 3. Shifting and Dash still respect their own costs and cooldowns.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Cat powershift.description:
Deliberately leave your current form, then attempt Cat Form. A cooldown or insufficient mana can leave you in caster form; this macro cannot test those conditions before canceling. It always returns to Cat, not the previous form.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Caster heal.description:
Leave form, then cast Rejuvenation on a living friendly mouseover, a living friendly target, or yourself. Stays in caster form afterward. The heal still needs mana and an available global cooldown.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Form attack.description:
Bear (slot 1): Maul. Cat (slot 3): Claw. Caster (no form): Wrath. Other forms do nothing. Maul queues a melee swing; the macro does not change your form or choose a rotation.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Moonkin form.description:
Enter Moonkin Form without toggling it off on repeated presses. Requires the talent/form to be learned; no numbered form slot is needed.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Cat/caster key.description:
No Shift: enter Cat Form and stay there. Hold Shift: leave your current form and stop the macro, so it cannot immediately re-enter Cat. This sample does not depend on form-slot numbering.

Numbered examples assume Bear=1 and Cat=3. Learned forms can change these slots: run Inspect forms in game and adjust [form:N] / [noform:N]. Shifting still needs mana and respects cooldowns.

Ghost Wolf.description: Enter Ghost Wolf without toggling it off on repeated presses. Cast time and location restrictions still depend on your character and the client.

Shadowform heal.description: Cancel Shadowform, then Flash Heal a living friendly mouseover, a living friendly target, or yourself. This does not re-enter Shadowform after healing.

Stealth opener.description: While stealthed, attempt Ambush; otherwise use Sinister Strike. Ambush's weapon, position, and energy requirements still apply. Omits /startattack so a failed opener does not start auto-attacking.

Stealth entry.description: Enter Stealth out of combat when not already stealthed. Repeated presses do not cancel Stealth; the ability's cooldown still applies.

Print location.description: Print your current map ID using the client API.

body: /run for i=1,GetNumShapeshiftForms() do local _,a,_,s=GetShapeshiftFormInfo(i); print(i,s,s and C_Spell.GetSpellName(s) or "?",a and "*" or "") end
Inspect forms.description: Run in WoW to print each learned stance/form's slot, spell ID, and name; * marks the active form. Use the first number in [form:N] or [stance:N], not the spell ID. Caster/no form is 0.
